status_note: Enabled when created. This local view does not query live scheduler status; app automation settings are authoritative.
notifications: Completed material test/portfolio outcomes or genuine user-action blockers only. A worthwhile lead triggers continued development/testing, not a standalone alert.
research_objective: Find academic market hypotheses that can become testable trading strategies for evaluation, funded or personal portfolios. Execution/risk references support this objective.
blocked_lead_policy: Record specific worthwhile missing-data leads once and move on. No repeated unchanged acquisition loops; parked leads do not preempt compatible research.
handoff_policy: Proceed autonomously through all earned gates and current-portfolio BASE/ADD/REPLACE/EMPTY comparisons; provide reproducible results for the user to send to Claude. Independent verification remains pending until completed.
batch_checkpoint_policy: Per-cycle limits are checkpoints within persistent discovery; blocked/rejected leads do not end the authorized search. Overall10hypotheses/30definitions and all gates preserved.
